summary: Part 3 of the Seller onboarding training (08:29 to 10:49, last spoken line; video length 10:50) covers preparing the first shipment (what goes in the box, bubble wrap, stickers, USB-C cables, box and airway bill, Quickup pickup and following the shipment in the Fulfillment App), how condition grades appear in the Fulfillment App SKU list, the Quality guidelines PDF (accepted standards per Excellent, Very good and Good grade, and the functions checked), and the four onboarding stages with the warehouse inspection outcome. Only the 18 listed frames were used; the transcript and frames are the sole sources.

evidence.quote: Quality screening bullets: 'Once your profile is validated, you will get access to the Fulfillment App', 'You will send us a 1st shipment of devices that will enable us to check your quality', 'Create a shipment, select products products, set quantities and prices'.

unclear.issue: Sticker placement conflicts. Speech says to put a sticker on every device; the slide says 'On the bubble wrap put a sticker'. Which one applies is not settled, so placement is not stated as a fact beyond the slide wording.
Speech says 'put everything in a random box'; the slide says 'Put everything in a box'. Whether 'random' means any box or is a mishearing is unclear.
Speech ends 'put the airway bill on the' with no object, and the slide does not mention the airway bill. Where the airway bill goes is not stated.
The sentence 'and will collect one day after QuickUp will deliver it to us' is garbled. The timing of collection (one day after what) cannot be determined.

Speech at 09:46 says 'very good', while the panel shown over that part (t00583, 09:43) is iphone-12-pro128 GBGoodSilver, which is Good. The Very good example (t00588) appears at 09:48. Which grade the trainer named at 09:46 is not settled.

Speech says the conditions are read 'on the onboarding app', but the screen shows the guidelines as Quality guidelines.pdf in a separate Preview window. The slide at 10:40 says profile screening gives access to the guidelines. Where sellers get the guidelines is not clear.

Camera dot allowance conflicts. General guidelines: Camera dot None (Excellent), 1 small maximum (Very good), 2 small maximum (Good). Functions deep dive Cameras row: max 1 small camera dot (Excellent), max 2 (Very good and Good). Which rule governs is unclear.

Cell boundaries in the Screen and Body rows of the PDF are hard to read in the frame. They are read as Excellent and Very good sharing 'No sign of use' (Screen), and Very good and Good sharing the Body allowance; confirm against the PDF.
The narration calls the Display area 'the lcd'; the PDF says 'Display'. Treated as the same row, but not confirmed by speech.
The clause 'we accept also some very slight differences in terms of replacement' has a low-confidence word ({we?}); the sense is inferred from the surrounding speech and the Display row only.
The contact channel for questions is not stated (the speech has a low-confidence word, {check?}, and no method is shown). Only that questions are welcome is clear.
Quantities recommended, Price, SKU Status ('Free market') and the star icons on product rows are shown on screen but never explained by the trainer. Their meaning is unknown.
Only page 1 of the 6-page Quality guidelines PDF is shown in the window title and page counter. The rest of the guidelines are not shown in this part.
